body.condition: For each \(a\in M\), the \(n_a\) available viewwise observations form an independent and identically distributed sample from the \(a\)-marginal of \(P\).

novel.justification: This is the marginal-retention component of the calibration-plus-marginals design: additional viewwise observations come from the same target population as the calibration cohort. No independence across covariance estimators is imposed; the calibration observations may be included in a view's marginal sample, and independence across sources is available only when cohorts are disjoint. Selection and transport are excluded.
